footSliding.label: החלקת רגליים
footSliding.description: Maximum horizontal sole displacement from the first sample of each declared support window, divided by character height. Inferred support is used only when no windows were supplied.

floorPenetration.label: חדירה לרצפה
floorPenetration.description: Maximum depth of the supplied sole probe points and all skeletal joint centers below the declared floor plane, divided by height. Sole probes are not a mesh collision audit.

posePops.label: קפיצות פוזה
posePops.description: Maximum adjacent 60 Hz-equivalent step: root-relative marker displacement / 0.04 height, root-relative rotation / 15 degrees, or root translation / 0.08 height. A fast continuous action can also exceed this screening threshold.

anatomy.label: חריגות אנטומיות
anatomy.description: Percentage of frames with elbow or knee flexion above 165 degrees, neck bend above 80 degrees, or a segment length changing by more than 5%. Optional calibrated hinge checks detect reverse knee flexion above 8 degrees. Conservative marker limits do not diagnose axial joint twist.

ballContact.label: מגע בכדור
ballContact.description: Maximum absolute distance from the ball surface to the sampled, bone-transformed declared contact point, divided by height. Events are evaluated at their exact declared times by interpolation.

continuity.label: כניסה ויציאה מול המתנה
continuity.description: Worst entry/exit mismatch to the best matching idle phase: RMS marker error / 0.04 height, RMS bone rotation / 25 degrees, or RMS endpoint velocity error / 0.75 height per second. Horizontal root translation is aligned; root height and body pose remain measurable.

bodySliding.label: מהירות גוף מול צעדים
bodySliding.description: Relative difference between average root travel speed and the median backward support-foot sweep speed relative to the root. Cadence and implied stride lengths are also reported. In-place clips need an explicit reference travel scenario; stationary actions are not scored as locomotion.

symmetry.label: סימטריה
symmetry.description: Maximum bilateral segment-length mismatch. Looping locomotion additionally compares reflected half-cycle leg markers; explicit pose symmetry compares simultaneous bilateral markers. One-sided actions retain unscored motion diagnostics, so a valid kick or dribble arm is not penalized for intentional asymmetry.

limitations: Skeleton and declared sole/contact points are audited; compressed mesh geometry and texture pixels are not decoded.
Reference-root paths describe the author scenario. Actual simulation speed/IK/blending are not executed.
Feeling score is a reproducible weighted diagnostic heuristic, not a perceptual or medical validation.
Missing applicable metadata is unavailable and earns zero points; not-applicable metrics are excluded. Coverage is shown.

In-place clips need an explicit reference travel scenario; stationary actions are not scored as locomotion.

reasons.label: כניסה ויציאה מול המתנה
reasons.reason: Worst entry/exit mismatch to the best matching idle phase: RMS marker error / 0.04 height, RMS bone rotation / 25 degrees, or RMS endpoint velocity error / 0.75 height per second. Horizontal root translation is aligned; root height and body pose remain measurable.
